-- ====================================================================
-- Script: Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition) - 3 вкладки + рабочие слайдеры
-- ====================================================================

--[[
    WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
--Open source by EricBerpa (Auto Bond logic)

--// WindUI
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

--// Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--// ====================================================================
--// МОДУЛИ DEAD RAILS
--// ====================================================================
local world, comps, replicator, Remotes, PlayerData, Event
local moduleSuccess, moduleErr = pcall(function()
    world = require(RS.Shared.Universe.ECS.world)
    comps = require(RS.Shared.Universe.ECS.components)
    replicator = require(RS.Client.Universe.Replication.clientReplicator)
    Remotes = require(RS.Shared.Universe.Remotes)
    PlayerData = require(RS.Client.Universe.PlayerDataController)
    Event = RS.Shared.Universe.Network.RemoteEvent.Actionable
end)

if not moduleSuccess then
    warn("[Vape V4] Модули Dead Rails не загружены: " .. tostring(moduleErr))
end

--// ====================================================================
--// СОСТОЯНИЕ
--// ====================================================================
local State = {
    AutoBond = false,
    FastFarm = false,
    WholeMap = true,
    MaxScanID = 100000,
    Method = "Vape Motion",
    Notifications = true,
    ShowCounter = true,
    BondCount = 0,
    Transparency = 0.2,
    Theme = "Dark",
}

local collectedBonds = {}

--// ====================================================================
--// ЛОГИКА AUTO BOND
--// ====================================================================
local autoBondThread = nil

local function startAutoBond()
    if autoBondThread then return end

    autoBondThread = task.spawn(function()
        while State.AutoBond do
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                local char = world:get_resource(comps.ClientStateResource).localCharacter
                if char then
                    if not world:has(char, comps.Sack) then
                        world:add(char, comps.Sack)
                        world:set(char, comps.Sack, { contents = {}, maxContents = 10 })
                    end

                    for id = 1, State.MaxScanID do
                        if world:has(id, comps.Storable) and world:get(id, comps.ObjectId) == "bond" then
                            if not collectedBonds[id] then
                                collectedBonds[id] = true
                                State.BondCount = State.BondCount + 1
                            end

                            local sr = replicator:get_server_entity(id)
                            if sr and sr ~= id then
                                Remotes.Store:FireServer(sr)
                                Remotes.Store:FireServer()
                                Event:FireServer(sr)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not ok then
                warn("[Авто Бонд] Ошибка: " .. tostring(err))
            end
            task.wait(State.FastFarm and 0.1 or 0.5)
        end
        autoBondThread = nil
    end)
end

local function stopAutoBond()
    State.AutoBond = false
end

--// ====================================================================
--// HUD
--// ====================================================================
local hudParent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "VapeBondHUD"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = hudParent

local counterLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
counterLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 44)
counterLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
counterLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
counterLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
counterLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
counterLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
counterLabel.TextScaled = true
counterLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
counterLabel.Text = "Бонды: 0"
counterLabel.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = counterLabel

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    counterLabel.Visible = State.ShowCounter and State.AutoBond
    counterLabel.Text = "Бонды: " .. State.BondCount
end)

--// ====================================================================
--// ИНТЕРФЕЙС WindUI
--// ====================================================================
local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition)",
    Author = "EricBerpa",
    Folder = "VapeV4Config",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 460),
    Transparent = true,
    Theme = State.Theme,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 1: АВТО БОНД
local BondTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Авто Бонд",
    Icon = "coins",
})

local BondSection = BondTab:Section({ Title = "Фарм облигаций" })

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Авто Бонд",
    Desc = "Автоматический сбор облигаций по всей карте",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.AutoBond = v
        if v then
            startAutoBond()
            if State.Notifications then
                WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Авто Бонд", Content = "Включен", Duration = 3 })
            end
        else
            stopAutoBond()
            if State.Notifications then
                WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Авто Бонд", Content = "Выключен", Duration = 3 })
            end
        end
    end,
})

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Весь сервер (по всей карте)",
    Desc = "Сканировать все ID на карте",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.WholeMap = v
    end,
})

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Быстрый фарм",
    Desc = "Ускоренный режим сбора (задержка 0.1 сек)",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.FastFarm = v
    end,
})

BondSection:Slider({
    Title = "Лимит сканирования ID",
    Desc = "Максимальный ID для сканирования (больше = дольше цикл)",
    Min = 10000,
    Max = 500000,
    Default = 100000,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.MaxScanID = math.floor(tonumber(v) or 100000)
        if State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Лимит ID",
                Content = "Установлен: " .. tostring(State.MaxScanID),
                Duration = 2,
            })
        end
    end,
})

BondSection:Dropdown({
    Title = "Метод фарма",
    Desc = "Способ обхода античита",
    Values = { "Vape Motion", "Vanilla TP", "Safe Tween" },
    Default = "Vape Motion",
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Method = v
    end,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 2: КАСТОМИЗАЦИЯ
local CustomTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Кастомизация",
    Icon = "settings",
})

local UISection = CustomTab:Section({ Title = "Интерфейс" })

UISection:Toggle({
    Title = "Уведомления",
    Desc = "Всплывающие уведомления о событиях",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Notifications = v
    end,
})

-- ✅ РАБОЧИЙ слайдер прозрачности
UISection:Slider({
    Title = "Прозрачность UI",
    Desc = "Прозрачность окна меню (0 = непрозрачно, 100 = полностью прозрачно)",
    Min = 0,
    Max = 100,
    Default = 20,
    Callback = function(v)
        v = tonumber(v) or 20
        State.Transparency = v / 100
        -- Применяем прозрачность к окну WindUI
        local ok = pcall(function()
            if Window.SetTransparency then
                Window:SetTransparency(State.Transparency)
            elseif Window.ChangeTransparency then
                Window:ChangeTransparency(State.Transparency)
            elseif Window.SetOpenTransparency then
                Window:SetOpenTransparency(State.Transparency)
            end
        end)
        if not ok and State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Прозрачность",
                Content = "Значение: " .. v .. "%",
                Duration = 2,
            })
        end
    end,
})

-- ✅ РАБОЧИЙ дропдаун темы
UISection:Dropdown({
    Title = "Тема",
    Desc = "Цветовая схема интерфейса",
    Values = { "Dark", "Darker", "Light", "Blood", "Ocean", "Purple", "Green", "Blue", "Pink", "Amethyst", "Rose" },
    Default = "Dark",
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Theme = v
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            WindUI:SetTheme(v)
        end)
        if State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Тема",
                Content = ok and ("Установлена: " .. v) or ("Ошибка: " .. tostring(err)),
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end
    end,
})

local CounterSection = CustomTab:Section({ Title = "Счётчик" })

CounterSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Показывать счётчик",
    Desc = "Отображать HUD со счётчиком облигаций",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.ShowCounter = v
    end,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 3: ИНФО
local InfoTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Инфо",
    Icon = "info",
})

local StatsSection = InfoTab:Section({ Title = "Статистика" })

StatsSection:Button({
    Title = "Сбросить счётчик",
    Desc = "Обнулить счётчик и очистить таблицу собранных бондов",
    Callback = function()
        State.BondCount = 0
        collectedBonds = {}
        WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Vape V4", Content = "Счётчик сброшен", Duration = 3 })
    end,
})

StatsSection:Button({
    Title = "Переподключиться",
    Desc = "Выйти из игры (для реджойна на новый сервер)",
    Callback = function()
        LocalPlayer:Kick("Rejoin")
    end,
})

local InfoSection = InfoTab:Section({ Title = "О скрипте" })

InfoSection:Button({
    Title = "Показать статус",
    Desc = "Вывести информацию в консоль (F9)",
    Callback = function()
        print("=== Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition) ===")
        print("Модули Dead Rails:", moduleSuccess and "OK" or "FAILED")
        print("Авто Бонд:", State.AutoBond and "ВКЛ" or "ВЫКЛ")
        print("Лимит ID:", State.MaxScanID)
        print("Быстрый фарм:", State.FastFarm and "ВКЛ" or "ВЫКЛ")
        print("Метод:", State.Method)
        print("Тема:", State.Theme)
        print("Прозрачность:", State.Transparency)
        print("Бондов собрано:", State.BondCount)
    end,
})

WindUI:Notify({
    Title = "Vape V4 (Dead Rails)",
    Content = "Загружено. Слайдеры и темы теперь работают.",
    Duration = 5,
})

-- whatHub v1.5 Full Integrated (Enable All Settings master toggle)
-- Last edited: 2025-09-11
-- add me on discord: tennisballs9000

if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DarkNetworks/Infinite-Yield/main/latest.lua'))()

-- ===== Services =====
local Players            = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService         = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace          = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInput          = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting           = game:GetService("Lighting")
local StarterGui         = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local ReplicatedStorage  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Remove any previous whatHub GUIs
pcall(function()
    local pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    for _, gui in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
        if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and (gui.Name:match("^whatHub") or gui.Name:match("^whatHub_v")) then
            gui:Destroy()
        end
    end
end)

-- Rayfield loader - try a few times
local Rayfield
do
    local attempts, maxAttempts, lastErr = 0, 3, nil
    while attempts < maxAttempts do
        attempts = attempts + 1
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()
        end)
        if ok and res then
            Rayfield = res
            break
        else
            lastErr = res
            task.wait(0.6)
        end
    end
    if not Rayfield then
        pcall(function()
            StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "whatHub v1.5",
                Text = "Rayfield failed to load, UI will use fallback.",
                Duration = 6
            })
        end)
        Rayfield = {
            CreateWindow = function() 
                return {
                    CreateTab = function() 
                        return {
                            CreateButton = function(_) end,
                            CreateToggle = function(_) end,
                            CreateSlider = function(_) end,
                            CreateSearch = function(_) end,
                            CreateDropdown = function(_) end
                        } 
                    end
                }
            end,
            Notify = function() end
        }
    end
end

-- Safe debug printing
local function dprint(...)
    if _G.whatHubDebug then
        local args = table.pack(...)
        local out = {}
        for i = 1, args.n do out[i] = tostring(args[i]) end
        print("[whatHub DEBUG]", table.concat(out, " "))
    end
end

-- Window
local Window
pcall(function()
    Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
        Name = "whatHub v1.5",
        LoadingTitle = "whatHub Loader",
        LoadingSubtitle = "Made by tennisballs9000",
        ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
        KeySystem = false
    })
end)
Window = Window or { CreateTab = function() return { CreateButton = function() end, CreateToggle = function() end, CreateSlider = function() end, CreateSearch = function() end } end }

local function notify(title, content, dur)
    dur = dur or 3
    pcall(function() Rayfield:Notify({ Title = title, Content = content, Duration = dur }) end)
end

-- Character refs - keep updated
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid  = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local HRP       = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function updateCharRefs(char)
    if not char then return end
    Character = char
    Humanoid  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    HRP       = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    dprint("Character refs updated")
end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(updateCharRefs)

-- Helpers
local function setNoclip(state)
    if not Character then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(Character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = not state end)
        end
    end
end

local function safeTeleportToCFrame(cf)
    if not Character or not HRP then return false end
    setNoclip(true)
    pcall(function() HRP.CFrame = cf end)
    task.wait(0.12)
    setNoclip(false)
    return true
end

-- streamed-area check
local function isAreaStreamed(position, radius, minParts)
    radius = radius or 25
    minParts = minParts or 6
    local ok, parts = pcall(function() return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, radius) end)
    if not ok or not parts then return false end
    local cnt = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then cnt = cnt + 1 end
    end
    return cnt >= minParts
end

-- Tabs
local MovementTab = Window:CreateTab("Movement", 4483362458)
local LegitTab     = Window:CreateTab("Legit", 4483362458)
local StagesTab    = Window:CreateTab("Stages", 4483362458)
local OtherTab     = Window:CreateTab("Other", 4483362458)
local OptimizationTab  = Window:CreateTab("Optimization Machine 9000", 4483362458) -- replaced Settings tab with Optimization
local EventsTab    = Window:CreateTab("Events", 4483362458)

-- Movement defaults
local DEFAULT_WALK = 16
local DEFAULT_JUMP = 50
_G.whatHubDebug = false
_G.whatHub_ws = _G.whatHub_ws or DEFAULT_WALK
_G.whatHub_jp = _G.whatHub_jp or DEFAULT_JUMP

MovementTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "WalkSpeed",
    Range = { DEFAULT_WALK, 500 },
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = _G.whatHub_ws,
    Flag = "WH_WalkSpeed",
    Callback = function(v)
        _G.whatHub_ws = v
        if Humanoid then pcall(function() Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v end) end
    end
})

MovementTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "JumpPower",
    Range = { DEFAULT_JUMP, 500 },
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = _G.whatHub_jp,
    Flag = "WH_JumpPower",
    Callback = function(v)
        _G.whatHub_jp = v
        if Humanoid then pcall(function() Humanoid.JumpPower = v end) end
    end
})

local NoSlowdown = false
MovementTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "No Slowdown",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "WH_NoSlow",
    Callback = function(v)
        NoSlowdown = v
        notify("Movement", "NoSlow " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF"))
    end
})

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if Humanoid then
        pcall(function()
            if _G.whatHub_ws and Humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= _G.whatHub_ws and not NoSlowdown then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = _G.whatHub_ws end
            if _G.whatHub_jp and Humanoid.JumpPower ~= _G.whatHub_jp and not NoSlowdown then Humanoid.JumpPower = _G.whatHub_jp end
            if NoSlowdown then
                if Humanoid.WalkSpeed < DEFAULT_WALK then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = DEFAULT_WALK end
                if Humanoid.JumpPower < DEFAULT_JUMP then Humanoid.JumpPower = DEFAULT_JUMP end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- Legit helpers
local function playNotificationSound()
    pcall(function()
        local s = Instance.new("Sound")
        s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://12222124"
        s.Volume = 0.18
        s.Parent = Workspace
        s:Play()
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(s, 3)
    end)
end

LegitTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Show Code",
    Callback = function()
        local codeVal = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CodeDoor") and Workspace.CodeDoor:FindFirstChild("Code")
        if codeVal and codeVal:IsA("StringValue") then
            playNotificationSound()
            notify("Door Code", "Code: " .. tostring(codeVal.Value), 6)
        else
            playNotificationSound()
            notify("Door Code", "Code not found", 4)
        end
    end
})

-- Light switch toggle (uses ClickDetector interaction)
local lightActive = false
local lightTask = nil

LegitTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Light Switch",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        lightActive = state

        if lightTask then
            lightTask:Disconnect()
            lightTask = nil
        end

        lightTask = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local lightSwitch = workspace:FindFirstChild("light")
            if not lightSwitch then return end

            local interactive = lightSwitch:FindFirstChild("LightSwitch") and lightSwitch.LightSwitch:FindFirstChild("Interactive")
            local lightsOnBool = lightSwitch:FindFirstChild("LightsOn")
            if not interactive or not lightsOnBool then return end

            local clickDetector = interactive:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
            if not clickDetector then return end

            -- Only act if the state is not as desired
            if (lightActive and not lightsOnBool.Value) or (not lightActive and lightsOnBool.Value) then
                if not HRP then return end
                local originalCFrame = HRP.CFrame

                -- Teleport to switch
                safeTeleportToCFrame(interactive.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0))

                -- Simulate click (call MouseClick on ClickDetector)
                pcall(function()
                    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if player == LocalPlayer then
                            clickDetector.MouseClick:Fire(player)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end)

                -- Wait a short moment for boolvalue to update (or use a small poll to ensure)
                local waited = 0
                while waited < 2 and lightsOnBool and lightsOnBool.Value ~= lightActive do
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    waited = waited + 0.12
                end

                -- teleport back (fail-safe after 2 seconds if not matching desired state)
                safeTeleportToCFrame(originalCFrame)
            end
        end)
    end
})

-- Other settings (fog, ambience, haze, neon, killbricks, player events)
local OriginalLightingState = { FogStart = Lighting.FogStart, FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd }
local OriginalAtmosphereProps = nil
do
    local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if atm then OriginalAtmosphereProps = { Density = atm.Density, Offset = atm.Offset, Color = atm.Color } end
end

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "No Fog",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            OriginalLightingState.FogStart = Lighting.FogStart
            OriginalLightingState.FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
            Lighting.FogStart = 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = 1e9
            local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atm then pcall(function() atm.Density = 0 end) end
            notify("Other", "NoFog enabled", 2)
        else
            Lighting.FogStart = OriginalLightingState.FogStart or 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = OriginalLightingState.FogEnd or 1000
            local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atm and OriginalAtmosphereProps then
                pcall(function()
                    atm.Density = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Density
                    atm.Offset  = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Offset
                    atm.Color   = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Color
                end)
            end
            notify("Other", "NoFog disabled", 2)
        end
    end
})

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Disable Ambient Sounds",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        -- updated ambient sound targets per user request
        local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Rumble Ambience Interior Wind Turbo Shaft 5 (SFX)")
        local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
        if s1 and s1:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s1.Volume = v and 0 or 1 end) end
        if s2 and s2:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s2.Volume = v and 0 or 1 end) end
        notify("Other", "Disable Ambient Sounds " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF"), 2)
    end
})

-- haze toggle
local Atmos = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
if not Atmos then
    Atmos = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
    Atmos.Parent = Lighting
end
local originalHaze = Atmos.Haze

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Disable Haze",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            Atmos.Haze = 0
        else
            Atmos.Haze = originalHaze or 10
        end
        notify("Other", "Disable Haze " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF"), 2)
    end
})

-- Neon removal
local neonCache = {}
local function removeNeonNow()
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
            neonCache[obj] = Enum.Material.Neon
            pcall(function() obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic end)
        end
    end
end
local function restoreNeonNow()
    for part, mat in pairs(neonCache) do
        if part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function() part.Material = mat end)
        end
    end
    neonCache = {}

			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			input.Changed:Connect(function()  
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then  
					dragging = false  
				end  
			end)  
		end  
	end)  
  
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)  
		if dragging and (  
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch  
		) then  
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart  
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(  
				startPos.X.Scale,  
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,  
				startPos.Y.Scale,  
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y

		if IsValidTarget(player) then
			local character = player.Character
			local hitbox = character.Hitbox
			local aimPoint = GetAimPoint(hitbox)
			local distance = (aimPoint - origin).Magnitude

			if distance > 0.001 and distance <= Settings.MaximumDistance then
				local angle = GetAngleBetween(origin, direction, aimPoint)

				if angle < bestAngle then
					if not Settings.RequireVisibility or IsVisibleFromCamera(origin, aimPoint, character, hitList) then
						bestAngle = angle
						bestHitbox = hitbox
						bestAimPoint = aimPoint
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestHitbox, bestAimPoint
end

local function IsWeaponRay(ray)
	local originOffset = (ray.Origin - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude

	return originOffset <= Settings.CameraOriginTolerance and ray.Direction.Magnitude >= Settings.MinimumWeaponRange
end

local function HookedCast(ray, hitList)
	if Settings.SilentAimEnabled and IsWeaponRay(ray) then
		local hitbox, aimPoint = FindTarget(ray.Origin, ray.Direction, hitList)

		if hitbox then
			return hitbox, aimPoint, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), hitbox.Material
		end
	end

	return OriginalCast(ray, hitList)
end

local function MaintainAmmo()
	if not Settings.InfiniteAmmoEnabled then
		return
	end

	local gun = State.gun

	if not gun then
		return
	end

	local capacity = math.min(General.getammo(gun), Settings.MaximumAmmoGuard)

	if State.equipped == "primary" then
		if State.primarymode == "2" then
			if State.primarygrenades < 1 then
				State.primarygrenades = 1
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end

			if State.storedgrenades < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
				State.storedgrenades = Settings.ReserveAmmo
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end
		else
			if State.ammocount < capacity then
				State.ammocount = capacity
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end

			if State.primarystored < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
				State.primarystored = Settings.ReserveAmmo
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end
		end
	elseif State.equipped == "secondary" then
		if State.ammo2count < capacity then
			State.ammo2count = capacity
			Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
		end

		if State.secondarystored < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
			State.secondarystored = Settings.ReserveAmmo
			Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
		end
	end
end

local function ShouldAutoFire(hitList)
	if not Settings.AutoFireEnabled then
		return false
	end

	if not IsAlive() or not HasWeaponEquipped() then
		return false
	end

	if Settings.RequireMouseLocked and not IsMouseLocked() then
		return false
	end

	if State.equipped == "melee" and not Settings.AutoFireMeleeEnabled then
		return false
	end

	if State.reloading or State.equipping or State.taunting then
		return false
	end

	local hitbox = FindTarget(Camera.CFrame.Position, Camera.CFrame.LookVector, hitList)

	return hitbox ~= nil
end

GeneralFunctions.cast = newcclosure(HookedCast)

local renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	MaintainAmmo()

	local hitList = OriginalGetHitList()
	local autoFire = ShouldAutoFire(hitList)
	local playerHolding = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)

	if autoFire or playerHolding then
		State.Held1 = true
	else
		State.Held1 = false
	end
end)

getgenv().ArsenalCombatAssist = {
	Settings = Settings,
	FindTarget = FindTarget,
	IsWeaponRay = IsWeaponRay,
	MaintainAmmo = MaintainAmmo,
	ShouldAutoFire = ShouldAutoFire,
	OriginalCast = OriginalCast,
	Restore = function()
		GeneralFunctions.cast = OriginalCast
		renderConnection:Disconnect()
		State.Held1 = false
		getgenv().ArsenalCombatAssist = nil
	end,
}
